# Test files deliberately excluded from every pytest invocation, BY DECISION.
#
# Format: one entry per line, `path  # reason`.
#
# This file holds one thing only: exclusions somebody chose, with the reason
# they chose them. It is not the backlog.
#
# The backlog lives in FROZEN_BASELINE in scripts/check_test_enumeration.py —
# the 213 files that ran in no workflow at
# main@1c13147f45365c10d518356a429f757c740f3a06. Those are recorded, not
# excused: an entry there means "nobody has looked at this yet", while an entry
# here means "somebody decided, and said why".
#
# An earlier revision of this change put all 213 in this file under one shared
# reason. That satisfied the every-entry-has-a-reason rule in text and defeated
# it in substance: the file could no longer tell a decision apart from an
# oversight, and a list that cannot make that distinction stops being a recorded
# debt and becomes a standing permission.
#
# Rules the guard enforces here:
#
#   * An entry with no reason fails.
#   * An entry reusing the frozen baseline's reason text fails. That excuse
#     belongs to the paths measured at that commit; a new file must say why IT
#     is excluded.
#   * An entry whose file is enumerated now fails. A stale exclusion is a false
#     record of intent, so it must be deleted rather than left to rot.
#
# There are currently no entries. A new unenumerated test file fails CI until it
# is either enumerated or listed here with a reason of its own.
